question: Who among the following was one of the founders of the Deccan Education Society (1884)?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Deccan Education Society was founded in 1884 by a group of prominent Indian scholars and social reformers who were committed to promoting education and social reform in India. The society's founding members included:
 
 
• Mahadev Govind Ranade
 
• **Gopal Ganesh Agarkar**
 
• Vishnu Shastri Chiplunkar
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak (also known as Lokmanya Tilak)
 
• V.S. Apte
 
• V.K. Chiplunkar
 
• K.B. Bhandarkar
 
• M.V. Joshi
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** is also known as** Lokmanya Tilak** founded** the Lathi Club**.
 
• **The Lathi club** was organised to make the youth brave and to enable them to fight for the **freedom **of their country.
 
• He was the founder of the **Deccan Education Society.**
 
• He was one of the founders of the **Fergusson College (1885)** in Pune through the **Deccan Education Society**.
 
• He believed and gave the slogan** “Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it”.**
 
• Tilak was stated as the** “father of Indian unrest”** according to the book** “Indian Unrest” **written by Valentine Chirol.
 
• He joined the** Indian National Congress** in** 1890**.
 
• His important books are** Gita Rahasya **and **Arctic Home of the Vedas**.
 
• He was part of the **Lal-Bal-Pal** trio of leaders with **Lala Lajpat Rai** and **Bipin Chandra**.
 
• He published two papers – **Kesari **in **Marathi **and** Mahratta **in **English**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dadoba Pandurang

 
 
• He was also known as the panini of the Marathi language.
 
• He was a social reformer and linguist from Bombay, who wrote about religious reform and social reform like supporting widow-remarriage and education for women.
 
• He composed Dharma Vivechan under the name of Jagadvasi Arya.
 
• His famous works are Paramhansika Brahmadharma (1880), Shishubodh (published posthumously in 1884), and Vidhavasumarjan (1857).
 
• When the Gyan Prasar Sabha was established at Elphinstone College in Mumbai in 1848, he became its president. ​
 
 
 
• Vitthal Ramji Shinde
 
 
• He started the ‘Depressed Classes Mission’ in 1906, for the development of the Dalits.
 
• He did commendable works for the entry of untouchables into the temple, animal sacrifice during the festival of Holi, and the Murli tradition.
 
• He wrote the book Bhartiya Asprushyatecha Prashna, which was published in 1933.
 
 
 
• **Tulsiram** **-** 
 
 
• **Radha Swami Satsang** was founded in** 1861** by a banker** Tulsiram** also known as **Shivdayal Sahab **or **Swamiji Maharaj**. **Seth Shiv Dayal Ji** started his faith on **“Satnaam”** and **“Anami”**, but the name** Radha Swami **was coined by **Rai Saligram**. **Rai Saligram** used to address **Naraini Devi**.
 
 

2f
